The [[Temple of War]] (also known as '''The Forge''') is a mighty fortress of the [[Eternal]]s found in the center of [[the Fissure of Woe]]. The temple has a north and a south entrance. Both of these entrances are locked until the appropriate trigger event has been completed. The northern entrance from the [[Great Battle Field]] can be opened by killing the group of 3 [[Shadow Mesmer]]s guarding it. The southern entrance can be opened by defeating the near identical group guarding that entrance, which can be accessed most easily through the [[Spider Cave]].

The Temple of War is the home of the [[Eternal Forgemaster]] and has been surrounded by the [[Shadow Army]]. It is also the only place at which players can craft the exclusive [[obsidian armor]], after completing [[Restore the Temple of War]].
